notes: Cobblers’ Bridge exterior: broad deck, five balustrade bays on either side, six pairs of tall orb columns, two shorter triple-lamp columns, geometric cornice, long central pier with two open bays and end bearings. Fixed 279 m model datum and approximate 284.6 m deck. The unmodified standard viewer samples 278.480 m water. Deck height, carved details, foundations and retaining interfaces are ordinary-photo approximations.
